items.title: Dior Holders to Vote on Agache Merger as LVMH Shares Sag on US Wealth Jitters
items.why: Softer US wealth sentiment hitting LVMH shares is a signal to watch for affluent luxury demand.
items.summary_ai: Dior shareholders will vote on a merger with Agache as LVMH shares fall on US wealth concerns.
items.take: Softer US wealth sentiment hitting LVMH shares is a signal to watch for affluent luxury demand.
